text:
Maya S.: Morning — quick check: priming roll-out on canary 3 done; saw ~7% P99 drop vs baseline. Logs attached in canary bucket.

deploy-bot: canary deploy complete: kernel-priming/v2 -> 3 nodes (:rocket:).

Ryan L.: Nice. can you paste the probe cmd? want to re-run with a 2s window.

Maya S.: probe cmd:
```
for i in {1..100}; do curl -s -XPOST https://canary.internal/serve -d '{"prompt":"warmup","n":1}' -H 'Content-Type:application/json'; done
```

Ashish K.: saw KV hit-rate drop after node restart during the rollout — eviction threshold might be too aggressive.

Maya S.: yep eviction was 0.25. bumped to 0.5 on canary nodes; hit-rate jumped to 0.82.

Ryan L.: perf numbers?

Maya S.: before: P50 24ms, P95 180ms, P99 420ms, KV hit-rate 0.45. after: P50 22ms, P95 130ms, P99 320ms, KV hit-rate 0.82.

Ashish K.: OK. please open a small PR to adjust defaults + note in runtime docs.

Maya S.: will do. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/987 (draft) — includes config change and rationale.

Ryan L.: pinging @eng-runtime for quick reviews and any red flags.

Ashish K.: ack. will review after lunch. no blocking issues from my side.

Maya S.: blockers: need canary extended +2h to observe memory churn and long-tail.

Ryan L.: +1 to extension. monitoring dashboards look stable.

deploy-bot: canary window extended by 2h (requested by Ryan L.).

Maya S.: thanks — will update thread with final numbers when extension completes. :thumbsup:
